I’d like to exchange the bicycle for a larger frame size for my kid, and swap the jigsaw puzzle for one with the same difficulty but with 1000 more pieces—if possible, I’d prefer an animal theme over art. Also, I want to exchange the camera for one with a slightly lower resolution, but I’d like to keep the other features the same.

And, in a different order, I’d like to cancel the skateboard. Can you help me with all of that?
Sure! My name is Sofia Li and my zip code is 78260. I actually don’t remember which email I used, but hopefully this info helps you find my orders.

I don’t have the order IDs handy, sorry! If you could look up my recent orders, that would be great. The bicycle, jigsaw puzzle, and camera were all in the same order, and the skateboard was in a separate one. Let me know if you need any more details from me.

Yes, that’s all correct! For the exchanges, if there’s any price difference or refund, I’d prefer to use my other card on file instead of the one I originally used. And for the skateboard cancellation, the reason is “no longer needed.” Let me know if you need anything else from me.

Yes, please go ahead and proceed with those actions. I’d appreciate it if you could let me know what options are available for the exchanges before anything is finalized. Thanks for double-checking everything!

For the bicycle, I’ll go with the large frame size, red, mountain type.

For the jigsaw puzzle, I’d like the 1500 pieces, animals theme, intermediate difficulty option.

For the camera, I’ll choose the 20MP resolution, 3x zoom, SD card storage.

And yes, please use my other credit card on file for any payment or refund.

Let me know if you need anything else from me!
Yes, that all looks correct—please go ahead and proceed with those actions. Thank you for confirming everything!

That’s great, thank you for your help! I appreciate how thorough you were. I don’t need anything else right now. Have a good day! 

###STOP###
